question: Triaged needs-product-decision — needs a human/product call.
summary: Owner decision needed: use per-archetype Elo (new computation) or per-archetype win rate from the existing preaggregate table, and over what time period. Per-archetype win-rate data is already precomputed in _archetype_person_stats; showing the top player by win rate per archetype per season would be a simpler starting point.
